messages:
cs_ryan: Hey team, customer acme-app reporting sudden 503s starting ~11:03 UTC. They say it started after a high-throughput batch request. ticket: CS-1023 :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Incident INC-7892 created (priority=P1) and page sent to oncall.
aj: thanks, grabbing oncall. any customer repro or request id?
cs_ryan: they shared request-id=req_0a9f3c and container id sha256:0f3a... The error log snippet shows upstream worker exit + coredump.
maya: can you paste the last 6 lines from the runner log?
cs_ryan: sure — from hosted-runner-12:
```
2026-02-11T11:02:59Z ERROR upstream_runner: SIGSEGV at 0x7ffef9a1
2026-02-11T11:03:00Z INFO  infer: attempting graceful restart
2026-02-11T11:03:00Z ERROR cuda: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
2026-02-11T11:03:00Z ERROR kernel: aborting process
2026-02-11T11:03:01Z INFO  watchdog: respawned container sha256:0f3a...
2026-02-11T11:03:01Z WARN  gateway: 503 returned to client (upstream crash)
```
sam: looks like a GPU OOM during a batched-match request. did we roll any batching heuristic recently?
luis: yes — yesterday at 02:20 we flipped the dynbatch window and aggressive concat for embed/match.
aj: rollback candidate then. can we repro locally? steps from customer?
cs_ryan: customer sent a minimal repro curl: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/match` — payload has 8k contexts and qps spike ~250.
maya: running it in staging now with same model version (v3.1-quant) and batching enabled. keeps failing with OOM at ~p95.
eng-runtime: FYI we see increased GPU mem pressure from KV prefetch + concat path; quant swap increases memory transiently.
aj: mitigation: 1) disable dynbatch concat on hosted pools for that model, 2) route acme-app to dedicated fallback with smaller batch size, 3) roll hotfix to reduce max_batch to 8. who's on the rollback?
maya: I can patch the heuristic toggle (feature flag: infer.dynbatch.concat=false) and push to prod. will monitor.
cs_ryan: applied flag, ACME reports reduced 503s within 2 mins. they confirmed POSTs started succeeding. CS updated ticket. :white_check_mark:
eng-runtime: opening a follow-up to add guardrails when quant-swap + high-prefix-length present (PR #4123).
aj: add a post-incident task: add alert for transient mem spikes during model swap and auto-fallback to smaller batches. assign to luis.
luis: on it. I'll also add an integration test that simulates large context + quant swap.
cs_ryan: customer happy for now, will keep ticket open until we ship guardrails. thanks all.
ops-bot: Incident INC-7892 status -> mitigated.
maya: putting short runbook in #eng-runtime: steps to disable dynbatch concat + verify logs + sample query to validate.
sam: notes for postmortem: root cause = aggressive dynbatch concat + quantized model transient mem spike during batched-match hot-hand-off. recommendation = conservative default for concat and automatic fallback routing when mem pressure crosses threshold.
eng-runtime: we should also add a token-level telemetry tag to show when prefetch+concat paths are used per request. tracking in PR-4124.
cs_ryan: closing loop with customer tomorrow EOD. current status: mitigated, follow-up tasks created.
